We used Oy for several excursions in Thailand.

The first half-day at the elephant sanctuary went very well, as did the day trip to James Bond Island. So far, so good.

However, the last excursion—the three islands with snorkeling and an overnight stay with a local family—was a real disappointment. Despite the high price (€450 for the day and night), nothing that had been advertised was actually done: no fishing, no scooter, none of the promised activities.

We spent the evening talking with her, and she assured us she would return the next day with local products to help us bring back some souvenirs. We waited for her… she never came back.

In the end, we felt that many things were promised to entice us, but once we paid, nothing was followed up. This way of doing things left a very bad impression.

We are therefore very disappointed by this last experience and, unfortunately, we do not recommend Oy for the organisation of excursions.
